title: New Business - Producer Emailed Quote Before Presenting (Non-Negotiable Breach)

magellan.objection_detected: Client emailed back: 'Rate is too high, thanks anyway'
magellan.objection_handling_detected: No phone CENT handling. Agent emailed: 'Let me know if you change your mind.'

ezlynx.quote_presentation_order: Emailed PDF quote directly at 2:30 PM with note 'Here is the Progressive quote you requested' without scheduling or conducting a phone presentation.

transcript_snippet: EMAIL FROM PRODUCER TO PROSPECT: 'Hi Mark, attached is your Progressive auto quote for $185/month. Take a look and let me know if you want to move forward.'
